description: Normative XKhfs and XXhfs handshake transcripts (handshake.md §12, Decision D15): every message's bytes, h/ck/k/n after every token, and the final keys. The generator's Noise code reproduced byte for byte the earlier transcripts on which the two independent step-2 implementations agreed; these application-valid transcripts must be reproduced by both again. What is compared is the Noise message bytes (messages[].bytes) and the final values; the HS_HELLO/HS_MSG frames around them follow from frames.json.
conventions: hex is lowercase; inputs come from handshake.json, node-card.json and link.json (sources named per field)
steps: the state after each token; 'k' is the cipher key ('' when none) and 'n' the next nonce
ML-KEM-768: KEM_GENERATE = crypto/mlkem NewDecapsulationKey768(d ‖ z); KEM_ENCAP with fixed m = FIPS 203 ML-KEM.Encaps_internal(ek, m) (Go crypto/mlkem/mlkemtest.Encapsulate768)
h_before_payload is h right before EncryptAndHash(payload); for message 1 of XK it is h1 of the access proof (handshake.md §5)
final.session_secret = Noise HKDF(ck, "echofog/hs2/session-secret").o1; final.sid = HKDF-SHA256(session_secret, salt = h, info = "echofog/session2/id", 16)

transcripts.name: XKhfs

inputs.p1_source: handshake.json payloads.HsInit_xk.encoded (no access: a public responder; known_card_seq = the public card's seq)
inputs.p2_source: handshake.json payloads.HsResp.encoded (no card: the initiator's copy is current)

sealed_record_example.note: wire.md §8.4: plaintext = a MUX_STREAM frame (stream 4); aad = sid ‖ u64(n) ‖ class 1 ‖ varint path 0 ‖ varint pipe 0; sealed = u64(n) ‖ ChaCha20-Poly1305(k_i2r, nonce(n), aad, plaintext); record = u16(len) ‖ kind 1 ‖ sealed

checks: application-valid: every payload and card check of handshake.md §7 passes

transcripts.name: XKhfs-access-proof

inputs.p1_source: payloads.HsInit_xk_hidden: access{pass_id, proof = HMAC-SHA256(link.json invitation.access_secret, "echofog/hs2/access-proof" ‖ messages[0].h_before_payload)}, known_card_seq = the invitation card's seq

sealed_record_example.note: wire.md §8.4: plaintext = a MUX_STREAM frame (stream 4); aad = sid ‖ u64(n) ‖ class 1 ‖ varint path 0 ‖ varint pipe 0; sealed = u64(n) ‖ ChaCha20-Poly1305(k_i2r, nonce(n), aad, plaintext); record = u16(len) ‖ kind 1 ‖ sealed

checks: application-valid: a hidden responder holding link.json's access secret accepts P1.access; the invitation card lists only suite 0x0001

transcripts.name: XXhfs

sealed_record_example.note: wire.md §8.4: plaintext = a MUX_STREAM frame (stream 4); aad = sid ‖ u64(n) ‖ class 1 ‖ varint path 0 ‖ varint pipe 0; sealed = u64(n) ‖ ChaCha20-Poly1305(k_i2r, nonce(n), aad, plaintext); record = u16(len) ‖ kind 1 ‖ sealed

checks: same keys as the XK transcripts except the initiator static, which is the throwaway identity's own hs key (node-card.json initiator_throwaway.hs_sk); bare-address prologue

transcripts.name: XKhfs-rotation-prev-hs

inputs.p1_source: payloads.HsInit_xk_hidden: access{pass_id, proof = HMAC-SHA256(link.json invitation.access_secret, "echofog/hs2/access-proof" ‖ messages[0].h_before_payload)}, known_card_seq = the invitation card's seq

sealed_record_example.note: wire.md §8.4: plaintext = a MUX_STREAM frame (stream 4); aad = sid ‖ u64(n) ‖ class 1 ‖ varint path 0 ‖ varint pipe 0; sealed = u64(n) ‖ ChaCha20-Poly1305(k_i2r, nonce(n), aad, plaintext); record = u16(len) ‖ kind 1 ‖ sealed

checks: responder_s is node-card.json prev_hs (card/prev_hs_sk); handshake-transcript.json rotation.first_pass shows the failed pass with the current hs key

rotation.note: XKhfs-rotation-prev-hs, message 1 as received by a responder whose current hs key is node-card.json hs_sk and whose previous key is prev_hs

first_pass.p1_open: fails: the responder starts again with prev_hs

second_pass.p1_open: succeeds; only then does the access check run on P1
